acceptance.given: A governed fixture has a required declaration or its referenced section removed.

oracle.expected: The validator reports the applicable rule and the fixture's relative location for the missing declaration or referenced section.
forbidden: The validator reports the failure without identifying the applicable rule.
The validator reports the failure without identifying the relative location.
oracle.observable: Validator result findings include the violated rule identifier and a repository-relative location for the missing declaration or referenced section.

acceptance.then: The validation failure contains both the violated rule and the relative location.
acceptance.when: Run the skill validator against the modified governed fixture and inspect its structured findings.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the validator test covering removal of a required declaration or referenced section and assert that the failure identifies both its rule and relative location.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure missing required declarations or referenced sections produce findings that identify the governing rule and repository-relative location.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation output remains a structured failure; rollback restores prior rule-and-location reporting behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A fixture with a removed required declaration transitions from unchecked input to a validation failure carrying rule and relative-location metadata.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted validator test passes only when every missing required declaration or referenced section finding contains both the applicable rule and a relative repository location.
